atoms.b: In ancient Egypt, most people wore clothes made of a ((++light heavy)), white fibre called linen.
Women would wear tight, ankle-length ((++dresses sandals)).
Men wore short ((++skirts sharks)) called kilts that went to just above the knee.

instruction.text: Select the correct parts of this rich Egyptian’s fashion.

feedback.correct: Black eye make-up called kohl was worn by both men and women, because it was thought to protect people’s eyes from the sun.
Rich people wore wigs made from human hair that were held in place with beeswax.
As Egypt had so much gold, golden jewellery was very common. Men, women and children would all wear it.

instruction.text: Sort the fashion by who would wear it.
The ancient Egyptians invented many things to help look after their appearance. Do you think they had the following?

feedback.finish: The ancient Egyptians put a lot of effort into looking good, so it must have been important to them!
